_readme: VOICE DEMO ONLY. Not part of the story: a test scene that shows Adrian's inner voices. Speakers voice:<skill> are inner voices.

demo_intro.speaker: narrator
demo_intro.text: [color=#8a8a8a]VOICE DEMO. Not part of the story: a test of Adrian's inner voices.[/color]

demo_psy_passive.speaker: voice:psychology
demo_psy_passive.text: He's sizing you up. Not for the job. For whatever comes after it.

demo_inv_passive.speaker: voice:investigation
demo_inv_passive.text: Fresh scrape across his knuckles. Someone told him no this morning.

demo_ask_like.speaker: adrian
demo_ask_like.text: You don't like this job either.

demo_tom_like.speaker: tom
demo_tom_like.text: I don't have to like it.

demo_elo_1.speaker: voice:eloquence
demo_elo_1.text: Keep him talking. Men like him love to be asked about the war.

demo_psy_1.speaker: voice:psychology
demo_psy_1.text: Don't. He's a shut door. Push and you lose him.

demo_elo_2.speaker: voice:eloquence
demo_elo_2.text: Every door opens if you knock right.

demo_ask_war.speaker: adrian
demo_ask_war.text: You were over there, weren't you? France.

demo_narr_war.speaker: narrator
demo_narr_war.text: The room dropped a degree. Garrity's hand went still at his side.

demo_narr_go.speaker: narrator
demo_narr_go.text: He nodded once and left. Something close to respect.
